ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; ventral surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) with high-intensity pixels limited to localized barnacle clusters and water spray highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid contiguous low-intensity dark grey (approx. hex #2A2A2E) across the central and proximal surface; localized high-contrast clusters of brown/white pixels situated at the distal left and right tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the main trailing edge; edge is largely continuous with minor pixel-level deviations (<10 pixels) except at the barnacle-encrusted tips where topography is highly irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonies localized exclusively at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single visible linear pixel disruption (lighter than base pigmentation) oriented diagonally on the inner lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Diagonal linear scar on the lower right lobe; significant barnacle colonization on distal tips causing structural edge irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of barnacles at the extreme tips creates a unique high-contrast 'fringed' appearance against the dark fluke and blue water.
